subject: One stone golem
setting: in front of an old castle gate

baseline_prompt_en: One stone golem in front of an old castle gate stands still. Its broad stone feet meet the worn flagstones and its heavy limbs remain close to the torso. The rough rock surface has distinct edges around the knees and shoulders. Soft cloudy light reveals the stone texture while the dark gateway provides separation behind its outline. The frame gives the golem's stone body priority against the old gate.
